verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Workers deploys full-stack framework apps on Cloudflare's global network. Cloudflare Images delivers optimized media, and a community user reports great results serving static sites on CF Pages. Together these imply global delivery of static content. However, nothing in the pack documents Workers static asset hosting or edge caching behavior. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Workers static assets serving, edge caching/cache-control configuration, CDN cache behavior, and independent evidence of performance gains from edge caching.
